description:
About the company
 Our client is a technology company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Serve as an early infrastructure hire, owning cloud environments and delivery pipelines for a growing technical team. Work closely with the existing infrastructure engineer to strengthen current systems and deliver new projects as the organization scales.
 What you'll do
 - Own and extend the cloud footprint, including compute, networking, access management, storage and observability.
 - Keep infrastructure reproducible and reviewable through infrastructure-as-code tooling.
 - Run CI/CD pipelines end to end, improving reliability, speed and developer experience.
 - Work alongside the existing infrastructure engineer to execute on current architecture and remove blockers for engineering and research teams.
 - Keep systems healthy through monitoring and incident handling, while managing spend and tightening security across container orchestration environments.
 - Take on special projects such as new services, environments and tooling as the team grows.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Around 7 years of infrastructure engineering experience.
 - Deep, recent cloud experience running production workloads.
 - Strong ownership of infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD.
 - Background at a company with a very high engineering bar or a fast-moving startup.
 - Solid engineering fundamentals and the ability to write and ship production code.
 - Currently based in the Bay Area.
 Bonus points
 - Experience with machine learning infrastructure.
 - Experience in research-heavy environments or labs.
 - Electrical or mechanical engineering background.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 200,000 to 300,000 per year
 - Equity
 Location and work model
 - Palo Alto, CA, United States
 - On-site, 5 days per week in office
 - Full-time
